name: znetwork_get_local_player_key
description: zNetwork::GetLocalPlayerKey returns the cached DirectPlay local-player key.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison for znetwork_get_local_player_key now matches 0x489f70 with zero unmasked function-byte mismatches, and the g_zNetwork_LocalPlayerKey BSS data symbol at 0x56aa44 has zero unmasked data-byte mismatches.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x489f70 validates a direct return of g_zNetwork_LocalPlayerKey.
The native zNetwork identity smoke verifies zNetwork_GetLocalPlayerKey returns the cached local-player key.
